entities.summary: Aftab Karma Singh Pureval is an American attorney and politician serving as the 70th mayor of Cincinnati, Ohio, since January 4, 2022. He is a member of the Democratic Party. Aftab Pureval was a legal figures from Xenia (b. 1982-09-09, Xenia). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
